title: The Library walk says which shelf it wants before it looks for the search box
goal: A scripted playtest that opens the Library and types in its search box fails whenever the previous run left the shelf on a different tab, because the probe remembers the tab between runs. The walk should say which tab it wants first, so it passes whatever ran before it.
notes: Scripts/playtest/library-walk.json step 9 focuses "Search media" after a plain showLibrary action, which does not set LibraryPanel.scopeKey. showComponentShelf sets it to components; there is no equivalent for media or styles. Either add a scope field to the showLibrary action or add showMediaShelf/showStyleShelf alongside showComponentShelf in PlaytestAction.
acceptance: Running the Library walk twice in a row, with a components walk in between, passes both times
No walk depends on a shelf tab left behind by an earlier run
